evidence: The measured thicknesses of the synthesized MoS2 were B1, 1.6 and 2.3 nm for 6, 9 and 12 MoOx ALD cycles, respectively. These thicknesses correspond to mono-, bi- and tri-layer (1, 2 and 3l) MoS2, considering that the height of 1l MoS2 on SiO2 is B1 nm and the spacing between the first and second MoS2 layers is B0.6 nm (refs 3,4). The r.m.s. value for the MoS2 sulfurized at 600 /C176C is very low ( B0.4 nm) and is close to the r.m.s. value of the SiO2 substrate (0.37 nm). In contrast, the r.m.s. value of the MoS2 in the 800 /C176C case is relatively high (0.8 nm).
